title: HexLands Sizes Lang
description: Translations for world preset options for HexLands Sizes.
body:
# HexLands Sizes Lang

A resourcepack with translations for HexLands Sizes: https://modrinth.com/datapack/hexlands-sizes

Translations have to go in resource packs, not datapacks, so I had to ship them separately.

## Versions

I'll name the versions of this based on the versions of HexLands Sizes so it's clear how to match them up.

However, I likely won't upload a new version of this unless it's necessary.
Whatever is latest HexLands Sizes datapack should work with the latest version of this.
